name: stripe_invoice_fetcher_ts
description: Fetches Stripe invoices and their payment status, either one invoice by id or a filtered list for a customer, converting amounts out of Stripe's smallest currency unit.

invoice.description: A specific invoice id (in_...). Takes precedence over customer.

customer.description: Customer id (cus_...) to list that customer's invoices.

status.description: draft, open, paid, uncollectible or void.

apiKey.description: Stripe secret key; falls back to the STRIPE_SECRET_KEY environment variable.
